description: Forward an existing message to another channel using Discord's native forward, which preserves the original attribution. Works across text channels and threads. Use discord_send_message to compose new content instead. Requires the Send Messages permission in the target channel. Returns a confirmation.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread containing the source message.

message_id.description: ID of the message to forward.

target_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the destination channel or thread.

name: discord_forward_message
